impacts.statement: Several homes and businesses flooded, mostly on north sides of Solomon, Safford, and Thatcher. Bridges may be overtopped.
Bridges in Safford Valley closed and extensive agricultural flooding. Homes and structures closest to the river threatened.
Agricultural flooding begins from Solomon down to Thatcher. Water begins to threaten bridge approaches in the Safford Valley.
Water begins to approach agricultural fields.
